name: Dheeraj Saraswat
title: Frontend Web Developer
bio: Front-End Developer crafting scalable, high-performance UIs that delight users. I turn designs into interactive experiences and optimize every pixel for impact.
longBio: I'm a Frontend Developer specializing in building scalable, high-performance web applications using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. I focus on transforming complex business requirements into responsive, accessible, and maintainable user experiences. At JF Knowledge Centre, I contributed to the frontend revamp of a large-scale Learning Management System and an internal website builder platform, improving performance, scalability, and UI consistency. Previously, at SalaryBox, I developed dashboard systems, CMS modules, and workforce management applications while integrating REST APIs and optimizing frontend workflows. I enjoy building reusable component architectures, improving Core Web Vitals, and creating user-centric products that deliver measurable business impact. Beyond production work, I continuously explore modern frontend technologies, system design, performance engineering, and best practices to grow as a software engineer.
headline: From prototypes to production: scalable UIs are my playground.
